name: New York Steak with Green Bean & New Potato Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg green beans
0.681 kg new potatoes
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water and add salt; cover and bring to a boil.
Quarter the potatoes and transfer to a medium bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the steak in the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Trim the ends of the beans. Once the water is boiling, add the beans; cook until they are bright green and tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Once the steak has been transferred, add the potatoes to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender when pierced with a fork, 8 to 10 minutes.
Juice 1 lemon into a large bowl and cut the other half into wedges for serving. Add olive oil and Dijon to the lemon juice and whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice the shallots; add to the bowl.
Add the green beans and potatoes to the bowl; toss until the salad is combined.
Divide the steak and salad between plates. Garnish with lemon wedges for squeezing over top. Enjoy!
